0022600211.text: The Knicks (5-4, 3-2 at home) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9) in New York's 10th game of the season, with New York on a three-game winning streak and sitting 3rd in the Atlantic, 3 games back, and 5th in the East. Milwaukee, 15th in the East and 5th in the Central, 5.5 games back, has lost six straight and is 0-4 on the road, and both teams have injury concerns: Knicks guard Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle issue and is a game-time decision, while Bucks forward Gary Trent Jr. is day-to-day with an illness and is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
